head.t: Medtronic announces regulatory milestones for newest cardiac mapping and ablation software
head.x: Medtronic today announced regulatory milestones for software used with two cardiac ablation platforms, including US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) clearance and a CE mark for the latest Affera Prism-2 mapping software.

head.t: Medtronic receives US FDA Breakthrough Device designation for IN.PACT BTK drug-coated balloon
head.x: Medtronic has received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Breakthrough Device designation for its IN.PACT below-the-knee (BTK) drug-coated balloon.

head.t: Abbott, Medtronic, Dexcom and 9 others win NHS Scotland's £140m insulin pump and CGM framework
head.x: NHS National Services Scotland has awarded a new £140 million framework for insulin infusion pumps, continuous glucose monitoring systems and associated consumables, covering all NHS Scotland health boards and NHS Northern Ireland trusts.

head.t: Framework ending 30 September 2027: Endoscopy, Endourology and Oncology Ablation Consumables and Associated Products
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Medtronic Limited" (Lot 1, Lot 3). 58 suppliers on the framework.
